name: focus-hour-vscode
description: Focus map for Focus Hour: decisions, background tasks and PRs in a docked panel

commands.title: Focus Hour: Open Focus Map in Editor
Focus Hour: Restart Dashboard and Workers

focusHour.cliPath.description: Path to the focus CLI (bin/focus.mjs). Empty: the newest installed focus-hour plugin, found under ~/.claude/plugins/cache.

focusHour.port.description: First port to try for the dashboard (one port per repo).

focusHour.autoStart.description: Start the dashboard and the workers when a repo with .focus/config.json opens. They stop when the window closes.

focusHour.revealOnCheckpoint.description: Reveal the Focus map at checkpoints and early checkpoints.

focusHour.nodePath.description: Node executable for the focus CLI (empty: node on PATH, else the editor's own runtime).
